source_label: Per-player game logs captured from the official game books of the 2026-11-14 slate: minutes, points, rebounds, assists and the opponent, plus DNP/inactive rows with reasons. One row per player-game.

rows.dnp_reason: Injury/Illness - Right Achilles Tendon Repair / Surgery

coverage_note: Coverage is complete for the ten teams that played 2026-11-14. Players on teams that did not play 11/14 (and any earlier-game rows) are not in this capture; the scheduled refresh job (scripts/refresh_official.py) appends every completed game's game book each night.
